title: Which furnaces are needed for aluminium cylinder solution treatment, ageing and curing?
summary: Different heating units in one cylinder project require separate loading and transfer agreements. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s three proposals dated 19 May 2020 cover a vertical solution furnace with rack lifting and a movable water tank, a bogie-hearth ageing furnace, and a box-type rotary system for curing after winding. Match each stage to the workpiece's condition before checking racks, bogies and rotating supports. The documents do not establish a shared temperature programme or fixture for every stage.
